normalized.answer: 2002 writes 'The index-name subscript shall not be followed by a '+' or a '–'' with an en dash; 2023 SR9 uses a hyphen. Both are the minus sign of relative indexing, so the requirement is the same. SR-14.9.37.3-9 is the right pointer (2023 renumbered SR7 to SR9).

definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.179) and §2023:3.170 differ only in 'the subscript 'ALL'' versus 'the value 'ALL''. The index-name and other subscripts SR7 requires on a condition-name are the same.
